# LLVM-MinGW source archive

This directory contains the unmodified LLVM-MinGW 20260616 UCRT Windows x64 archive, split into deterministic 20 MiB byte chunks for ordinary Git storage. The original archive SHA-256 is `b9b68a4d276e16fa25802aaba458e4638f64b3884c290aaccdc2d87083b6ca35`.

Reconstruct and verify it with `tools/RestoreVendoredLlvmMingw.ps1`. Upstream project: https://github.com/mstorsjo/llvm-mingw. The extracted distribution retains the upstream license and notice files.
